stem: The first and last paragraphs offer which contradictory opinions?

options.label: A
options.text: Flying is no fun; flying is something to look forward to.

options.label: B
options.text: Oxygen masks are hard to use; airplane safety is important.

options.label: C
options.text: Airplane food tastes awful; passengers enjoy meals on airplanes.

options.label: D
options.text: Plastic deck chairs are ugly; the airplane cabin is pretty.
